Permits & Licenses
PERMIT
Residential building permit
For additions, kitchens, decks, and fence/site projects above 6 ft.
Online · $45 to $320 · 7-14 day review
LICENSE
General business license
Required for any business operating within the city limits. Renews annually.
Online · $75 to $140 · same-day issuance
EVENT
Block-party permit
Close your street to a neighborhood gathering. Apply 14 days ahead.
Online · $45 · 3-5 day review
FOOD SERVICE
Mobile food vendor permit
Trucks, carts, and pop-up stalls. Includes a 30-question food safety quiz.
In person · $90 to $210 · 10 day review

ASSISTANCE
Emergency rental assistance
Up to $8,000 in back rent for income-qualified households facing eviction.
Online · 30 day · 11 day decision
PROPERTY TAX
Property assessment appeal
Disagree with your 2025 assessed value? You have until April 15 to appeal.
Hybrid · $50 · scheduled hearing
ENFORCEMENT
Report a code violation
Junk, derelict cars, unsafe structures. Add a photo if you can.
Online · Free · Anonymous OK
TAX RELIEF
Senior homestead exemption
Property tax reduction for residents 65+ owning under $250,000.
By mail · Free · 2-3 week review

Online · Free · 72hr response

Schedule a hearing or submit written evidence within 30 days of issue.
Hybrid · $25 · scheduled hearing
